text: Sept 8, Beijing — China Council for the Promotion of International Trade (CCPIT) vice chairman Lin Honghong met HP Inc. chief legal officer and general counsel Julie Jacobs. Discussions covered support for foreign-invested firms operating in China, deepening international industr
text_zh: 9月8日，北京——中国国际贸易促进委员会（CCPIT）副会长林红红会见了惠普公司首席法务官兼总法律顾问朱莉·雅各布斯。双方就支持在华外资企业运营、深化国际产业合作等议题进行了交流。
